facts.title: Flow changes
facts.text: Existing buffs retained; successful steals grant +5% flow bar, with faster recovery from tackles and steals.

facts.title: Destructive Impulses balance
facts.text: Shot power and speed reduced 10%; skill cooldown reduction removed.

facts.title: Shot and tackle balance
facts.text: Base shot power reduced; extra tackles removed.

facts.title: Shot power multiplier
facts.text: Shot power increased from 1.2 to 1.35 at that date.

history.title: September quality of life
history.text: Watchtower added to Niko. Barou received aim and dribble adjustments; Loki and Lavinho were balanced. One goal counted as 1 MVP point and one save as 0.75. Per-style awakening outfits and party improvements arrived; summer map removed.

history.title: Flow balance and fixes
history.text: Numerous flow buffs and nerfs. Magician Flow moved to Legendary; Emperor cooldown reduction changed from 33% to 20%. Infinite Awakening added to PS+.

history.title: Nagi, Loki and Lavinho balance
history.text: Detailed nerfs and removals for Nagi and McNagi, Loki aerial trap removal, Lavinho balance and flow adjustments.

history.title: Ball physics and style balance
history.text: Ball physics made independent of FPS; King, Isagi, Yukimiya and flow balances announced.
